title: Pre-Kindergarten Admission: Age, State Eligibility Bases and Tuition-Based Places
content:
## Admission rules

1. **Age.** Under Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions, a Pre-K child must reach the age set for the grade on or before the Pre-K age cutoff of the year the school year starts. Age is judged from the student's date of birth on the student record.
2. **State eligibility.** Pre-Kindergarten (State-Eligible) admits a child with at least one accepted eligibility basis on file:
   - emergent bilingual, when the student record shows emergent bilingual identification;
   - free or reduced-price meals, when the student's School Nutrition Services Meal Account holds any Free Meal Status or Reduced-Price Meal Status tier;
   - homeless, when the student record shows homeless (McKinney-Vento) status;
   - foster care, when the student record shows foster care;
   - military-connected, when it shows a military-connected parent;
   - Star of Texas family, when a Pre-K eligibility proof document for that basis is logged on the enrollment.
3. **Carry-over to PK4.** A child admitted to PK3 on a basis stays eligible for PK4 the next school year, because the state-eligible type carries PK3 eligibility to PK4, even when the basis no longer holds.
4. **Tuition-based places.** A PK4 child with no basis may enroll on Pre-Kindergarten (Tuition-Based) when the household has no unpaid tuition balance from an earlier school year. The prior balance is the sum, over the household's enrollments of all school years before the school year being registered, of tuition charges, late fees and refunds less payments and credits; the child may enroll when that sum is zero or below.
5. **Moving to state-eligible Pre-K.** A tuition-based enrollment moves to state-eligible Pre-K only when an eligibility basis is on file for the student. On the move the enrollment takes the type Pre-Kindergarten (State-Eligible), the basis established is recorded, and the effective date recorded is the first day of the billing month from which tuition no longer applies.
6. **Timing and credits of the move (no longer in force).** The former clause that the move takes effect on the first day of the billing month after the basis is on file, that a tuition charge already posted for that month or a later one is credited in full with the credit reason "eligibility established", and that months before it remain owed, is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis for the move and its tuition credits.

The required ages, cutoff date and accepted bases are set in the district's Pre-K admissions guide.

## Prior balance test (hypothetical household)

| Earlier school years' charges, late fees and refunds | Earlier payments and credits | Prior balance | Tuition-based registration |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1,200.00 | 1,200.00 | 0.00 | may enroll |
| 1,200.00 | 1,270.00 | a credit of 70.00 (below zero) | may enroll |
| 1,200.00 | 1,140.00 | 60.00 owed | may not enroll on the tuition-based type |

## Bases checked against the records

The district's records decide each basis: the student record (emergent bilingual identification, homeless or foster care status, a military-connected parent), the student's meal account tier, or a logged eligibility proof document. A family's statement alone does not place a basis on file.

superseded_clauses: The move takes effect on the first day of the billing month after the basis is on file; a tuition charge already posted for that month or a later one is credited in full with credit_reason eligibility_established, and months before it remain owed.
